# Effects of the Western Crossing. Arguments are temporary variables zin_arg_<name> set just before the call (E1): value; how 0 peace 1 decided 2 escalated; route 1 divided 2 crossing 3 relief 4 hold; sailing 1 or 2; choice 1 claim 2 pledge; event 1 named 2 refused 3 released 4 fled; lift_factor.
zin_west_add_grudge = {
	add_to_variable = { zin_west_grudge = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_west_grudge min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0 }
}
zin_west_add_grudge_all = {
	set_temp_variable = { west_v = zin_arg_value }
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_west_is_western = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = west_v }
		zin_west_add_grudge = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0 }
}

zin_west_add_truce = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_truce_broken } }
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_west_truce = zin_arg_value }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_west_truce min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_west_truce < 1 } date > 1749.3.1 }
			zin_west_break_truce = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0 }
}

zin_west_break_truce = {
	# The truce breaks (truce at 0 after 1749.3.1, the historical date, or an end-the-truce decision): the feud at the ford starts as a border war. Gunwaith attacks unless Girdon broke it by its own choice.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_truce_broken } }
		set_global_flag = zin_west_truce_broken
		set_global_flag = zin_west_grey_ford_war
		if = {
			limit = { original_tag = Y08 NOT = { zin_west_historical = yes } }
			set_global_flag = zin_west_feud_girdon_attacked
		}
		Y07 = {
			if = { limit = { has_opinion_modifier = { target = Y08 modifier = zin_opinion_grey_ford_truce } } remove_opinion_modifier = { target = Y08 modifier = zin_opinion_grey_ford_truce } }
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = Y08 modifier = zin_west_ford_blood }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cb_broken_truce days = 730 scope = Y08 }
		}
		Y08 = {
			if = { limit = { has_opinion_modifier = { target = Y07 modifier = zin_opinion_grey_ford_truce } } remove_opinion_modifier = { target = Y07 modifier = zin_opinion_grey_ford_truce } }
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = Y07 modifier = zin_west_ford_blood }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_cb_broken_truce days = 730 scope = Y07 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_west_feud_girdon_attacked }
			start_border_war = {
				change_state_after_war = no
				combat_width = 80
				minimum_duration_in_days = 60
				attacker = {
					state = global.zin_site_winter_ford
					num_provinces = 4
					on_win = zin_west.23
				}
				defender = {
					state = global.zin_site_three_oaths
					num_provinces = 4
					on_win = zin_west.23
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			start_border_war = {
				change_state_after_war = no
				combat_width = 80
				minimum_duration_in_days = 60
				attacker = {
					state = global.zin_site_three_oaths
					num_provinces = 4
					on_win = zin_west.23
				}
				defender = {
					state = global.zin_site_winter_ford
					num_provinces = 4
					on_win = zin_west.23
				}
			}
		}
		Y07 = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				country_event = { id = zin_west.22 }
			}
		}
		Y08 = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				country_event = { id = zin_west.22 }
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_west_is_western = yes }
			news_event = { id = zin_west.25 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -10 }
		zin_west_add_unity = yes
	}
}
zin_west_end_ford_war = {
	# The single exit of the feud. zin_arg_how: 0 the war-king's peace (default), 1 decided by the border war (scope: the winner), 2 Gunwaith escalates.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_west_grey_ford_war }
		clr_global_flag = zin_west_grey_ford_war
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_west_feud_girdon_attacked }
			cancel_border_war = {
				attacker = global.zin_site_winter_ford
				defender = global.zin_site_three_oaths
				dont_fire_events = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			cancel_border_war = {
				attacker = global.zin_site_three_oaths
				defender = global.zin_site_winter_ford
				dont_fire_events = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_how = 1 }  }
			add_war_support = 0.05
			every_country = {
				limit = { OR = { original_tag = Y07 original_tag = Y08 } NOT = { tag = PREV } }
				add_stability = -0.05
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
			zin_west_add_unity = yes
			Y07 = {
				country_event = { id = zin_west.24 }
			}
			Y08 = {
				country_event = { id = zin_west.24 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_how = 2 } }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 25 }
			zin_west_add_unity = yes
			every_country = {
				limit = { has_idea = zin_eindil_war_kings_banner }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
				zin_west_add_grudge = yes
				if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_west_old_claims } remove_ideas = zin_west_old_claims }
			}
			Y07 = {
				diplomatic_relation = { country = Y08 relation = non_aggression_pact active = yes }
				if = { limit = { has_opinion_modifier = { target = Y08 modifier = zin_west_ford_blood } } remove_opinion_modifier = { target = Y08 modifier = zin_west_ford_blood } }
			}
			Y08 = {
				diplomatic_relation = { country = Y07 relation = non_aggression_pact active = yes }
				if = { limit = { has_opinion_modifier = { target = Y07 modifier = zin_west_ford_blood } } remove_opinion_modifier = { target = Y07 modifier = zin_west_ford_blood } }
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_west_is_western = yes }
			news_event = { id = zin_west.26 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_how = 0 }
}
zin_west_on_war_king = {
	# The one entry point for the war-kingship. zin_arg_event: 1 named, 2 refused, 3 released, 4 fled.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_event = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
		zin_west_add_unity = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_event = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -10 }
		zin_west_add_unity = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_event = 3 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
		zin_west_add_unity = yes
		set_global_flag = zin_west_remembers_war_king
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_event = 4 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -15 }
		zin_west_add_unity = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_event = 0 }
}
zin_west_convene_council = {
	# The scope is the convener.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_council } }
		set_global_flag = zin_west_council
		set_variable = { global.zin_west_convener = THIS }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 15 }
		zin_west_add_unity = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_west_is_western = yes }
			country_event = { id = zin_west.30 }
		}
	}
}
zin_west_set_route = {
	# zin_arg_route: 1 divided, 2 crossing, 3 relief, 4 hold. Sets the variable and the flag, and refreshes the western layouts (E4).
	set_variable = { global.zin_west_route = zin_arg_route }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_route = 1 } }
		set_global_flag = zin_west_route_divided
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_route = 2 } }
		set_global_flag = zin_west_route_crossing
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_route = 3 } }
		set_global_flag = zin_west_route_relief
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_route = 4 } }
		set_global_flag = zin_west_route_hold
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_route = 1 } }
		clr_global_flag = zin_west_council
		clr_global_flag = zin_west_route_crossing
		clr_global_flag = zin_west_route_relief
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_west_is_western = yes }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_west_own_shore days = 365 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			news_event = { id = zin_west.80 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_route = 2 } }
		clr_global_flag = zin_west_route_divided
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_west_is_western = yes }
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_route = 0 }
}
zin_west_call_pledges = {
	# The scope is the convener: the league is created and every western court is asked for its host.
	if = {
		limit = { is_in_faction = no }
		create_faction_from_template = zin_faction_western_crossing
	}
	set_variable = { global.zin_west_convener = THIS }
	save_global_event_target_as = zin_west_convener_target
	set_variable = { global.zin_west_pledged_count = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_west_is_western = yes }
		country_event = { id = zin_west.31 }
	}
}
zin_west_pledge_host = {
	# The scope joins the Crossing: the pledge is 2 + grudge / 20 hosts.
	set_country_flag = zin_west_pledged
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_west_pledged_count = 1 }
	set_variable = { zin_west_pledge = zin_west_grudge }
	divide_variable = { zin_west_pledge = constant:zin_west.pledge_grudge_step }
	round_variable = zin_west_pledge
	add_to_variable = { zin_west_pledge = constant:zin_west.pledge_base }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.zin_west_convener NOT = { zin_west_is_leader = yes } }
		var:global.zin_west_convener = {
			add_to_faction = PREV
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 2 }
	zin_west_add_unity = yes
}

		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_west_sailings = 0 } has_global_flag = zin_west_landing_isle NOT = { Y0T = { has_country_flag = zin_asgard_harbours_barred } } }

zin_west_create_host = {
	# The scope is a member: it pays and creates up to zin_arg_value hosts in the landing state (place of the starting force: the state's port province).
	set_temp_variable = { west_pay_men = zin_arg_value }
	multiply_temp_variable = { west_pay_men = constant:zin_west.pledge_men }
	multiply_temp_variable = { west_pay_men = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { west_pay_eq = zin_arg_value }
	multiply_temp_variable = { west_pay_eq = constant:zin_west.pledge_equipment }
	multiply_temp_variable = { west_pay_eq = -1 }
	add_manpower = west_pay_men
	add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = zin_arms_equipment amount = west_pay_eq }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_west_landing_state = 1328 } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			end = zin_arg_value
			create_unit = { division = "name = \"Crossing Host\" division_template = \"Crossing Host\" start_experience_factor = 0.4 start_equipment_factor = 0.8" owner = THIS prioritize_location = 3963 allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = yes }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_west_landing_state = 1329 } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			end = zin_arg_value
			create_unit = { division = "name = \"Crossing Host\" division_template = \"Crossing Host\" start_experience_factor = 0.4 start_equipment_factor = 0.8" owner = THIS prioritize_location = 4035 allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = yes }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_west_landing_state = 725 } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			end = zin_arg_value
			create_unit = { division = "name = \"Crossing Host\" division_template = \"Crossing Host\" start_experience_factor = 0.4 start_equipment_factor = 0.8" owner = THIS prioritize_location = 3822 allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = yes }

			create_unit = { division = "name = \"Crossing Host\" division_template = \"Crossing Host\" start_experience_factor = 0.4 start_equipment_factor = 0.8" owner = THIS prioritize_location = 4277 allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = yes }

zin_west_sail = {
	# One sailing (zin_arg_sailing 1 or 2); the scope is the leader.
	zin_west_pick_landing = yes
	set_temp_variable = { west_lift = global.zin_west_fleet }
	divide_temp_variable = { west_lift = constant:zin_west.lift_divisor }
	round_temp_variable = west_lift
	if = {
		limit = { zin_controls_sea_central_for_foe = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { west_loss = west_lift }
		divide_temp_variable = { west_loss = 4 }
		round_temp_variable = west_loss
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { west_lift = west_loss }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -10 }
		zin_west_add_fleet = yes
		country_event = { id = zin_west.44 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_west_landing_state = 1328 } }
		1328 = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { controller = { zin_west_in_crossing = yes } } }
				teleport_armies = { limit = { zin_west_in_crossing = no } }
				set_state_controller_to = PREV
				set_state_flag = zin_west_beachhead
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_west_landing_state = 1329 } }
		1329 = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { controller = { zin_west_in_crossing = yes } } }
				teleport_armies = { limit = { zin_west_in_crossing = no } }
				set_state_controller_to = PREV
				set_state_flag = zin_west_beachhead
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_west_landing_state = 725 } }
		725 = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { controller = { zin_west_in_crossing = yes } } }
				teleport_armies = { limit = { zin_west_in_crossing = no } }
				set_state_controller_to = PREV
				set_state_flag = zin_west_beachhead
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_west_landing_state = 727 } }
		727 = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { controller = { zin_west_in_crossing = yes } } }
				teleport_armies = { limit = { zin_west_in_crossing = no } }
				set_state_controller_to = PREV
				set_state_flag = zin_west_beachhead
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_west_landing_state = 968 } }
		968 = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { controller = { zin_west_in_crossing = yes } } }
				teleport_armies = { limit = { zin_west_in_crossing = no } }
				set_state_controller_to = PREV
				set_state_flag = zin_west_beachhead
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_west_landing_state = 192 } }
		192 = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { controller = { zin_west_in_crossing = yes } } }
				teleport_armies = { limit = { zin_west_in_crossing = no } }
				set_state_controller_to = PREV
				set_state_flag = zin_west_beachhead
			}
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_west_pledged check_variable = { zin_west_pledge > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_west_pledge }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_value > west_lift } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = west_lift }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_value > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { west_made = zin_arg_value }
			zin_west_create_host = yes
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { west_lift = west_made }
			subtract_from_variable = { zin_west_pledge = west_made }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_west_beachhead_host days = 180 }
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_west_sailings = 1 }
	event_target:zin_west_foe = {
		country_event = { id = zin_west.42 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_sailing = 0 }
}
zin_west_launch_crossing = {
	# The scope is the leader: the cause, the war, the pledged members, the first landing question.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_western_crossing } }
		set_global_flag = zin_western_crossing
		clear_global_event_target = zin_west_foe
		random_state = {
			limit = { zin_is_site_parim = yes controller = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes } }
			controller = {
				save_global_event_target_as = zin_west_foe
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_event_target = zin_west_foe } }
			Y0L = {
				save_global_event_target_as = zin_west_foe
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_story_war days = 1 }
		meta_effect = { text = { create_wargoal = { type = take_state_focus target = event_target:zin_west_foe generator = { [PARIM] } } } PARIM = "[?global.zin_site_parim|0]" }
		meta_effect = { text = { declare_war_on = { target = event_target:zin_west_foe type = take_state_focus generator = { [PARIM] } } } PARIM = "[?global.zin_site_parim|0]" }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_west_pledged NOT = { zin_west_is_leader = yes } }
			add_to_war = { targeted_alliance = PREV enemy = event_target:zin_west_foe hostility_reason = asked_to_join }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 10 }
		}
		zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
		country_event = { id = zin_west.40 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			news_event = { id = zin_west.41 }
		}
	}
}
zin_west_sail_first = {
	# Event .40 chose the landing; the first sailing leaves.
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_sailing = 1 }
	zin_west_sail = yes
}
zin_west_take_parim = {
	# The first time a member controls Parim: the news, then the leader chooses the throne or the pledge.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_parim_taken } }
		set_global_flag = zin_west_parim_taken
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			news_event = { id = zin_west.56 }
		}
		var:global.zin_west_convener = {
			country_event = { id = zin_west.57 }
		}
	}
}
zin_west_choose_parim = {
	# zin_arg_choice: 1 claim the throne of men, 2 hold Parim as a pledge. The scope is the leader.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_choice = 1 } }
		set_global_flag = zin_west_throne_claimed
		add_ideas = zin_west_claimant_of_parim
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes }
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_west_conquerors }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 3 }
		zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_global_flag = zin_west_parim_pledge
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -10 }
		zin_west_add_strain = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes }
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = zin_west_pledge_holders }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_choice = 0 }
}
zin_west_grant_surrenders = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_west_in_crossing = yes }
		add_ideas = zin_west_generous_conquerors
	}
}

zin_west_evac_state_roll = {
	# The scope is a Middle Lands state: with the lift chance (the fleet, at most 80 percent, times the lift factor) the member armies here are carried home.
	set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = west_roll min = 0 max = 100 integer = yes }
	set_temp_variable = { west_chance = global.zin_west_fleet }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { west_chance > 80 } }
		set_temp_variable = { west_chance = constant:zin_west.lift_cap }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_west_lift_factor < 1 } }
		divide_temp_variable = { west_chance = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { west_roll < west_chance } }
		teleport_armies = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_west_pledged } }
	}
}

	# The Western Relief: the pledged members join the Aenor realm's wars against the dark, as allies and never as conquerors. The scope is the leader.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_west_relief_granted NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_western_relief_sailed } }
		set_global_flag = zin_western_relief_sailed
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_west_pledged }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_government = communism } }
				set_country_flag = zin_lost_cause_member
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 15 }
			zin_eindil_add_regard = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
		zin_lost_cause_add_strength = yes
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -3 }
		zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			news_event = { id = zin_west.51 }
		}
	}
}
zin_west_join_coalition_effects = {
	# The scope joined Eindil's coalition (after zin_eindil_join_coalition): opinions both ways with the Host and the Aenor realms in it, the spirit, and the old claims are set aside.
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host }
		save_event_target_as = zin_west_joiner
		var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = event_target:zin_west_joiner modifier = zin_west_fought_beside }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = var:global.zin_eindil_host modifier = zin_west_fought_beside }
	}
	add_ideas = zin_west_beside_former_foes
	if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_west_old_claims } remove_ideas = zin_west_old_claims }
}

zin_west_pulse = {
	# Weekly: the launch, the feud, the raids and the Parim checks; every fourth pulse the monthly drift.
	if = {
		limit = { zin_west_crossing_ready = yes NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_western_crossing } has_variable = global.zin_west_convener }
		var:global.zin_west_convener = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes is_ai = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns }
					zin_west_launch_crossing = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_aurevan_crowned NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_15_fired } }
		set_global_flag = zin_west_15_fired
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_west_is_western = yes }
			country_event = { id = zin_west.15 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_western_crossing NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_parim_taken } zin_west_controls_parim = yes }
		zin_west_take_parim = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_western_crossing NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_keys_fired } has_global_flag = zin_afrit_king_of_east zin_west_past_keys_of_parim = yes check_variable = { global.zin_west_ashore > 7 } }
		zin_west_keys_check = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_western_crossing NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_evacuation } has_global_flag = zin_west_parim_taken OR = { zin_west_strain_high = yes AND = { has_global_flag = zin_zol_rising has_global_flag = zin_volgan_marches zin_west_past_shore_calls = yes } zin_west_past_shore_calls_late = yes } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_shore_called } }
		set_global_flag = zin_west_shore_called
		var:global.zin_west_convener = {
			country_event = { id = zin_west.60 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_west_route_hold NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_evacuation } check_variable = { global.zin_west_strain > 99 } }
		zin_west_host_breaks = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_west_route_crossing NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_fleet_rumour } check_variable = { global.zin_west_fleet > 39 } }
		set_global_flag = zin_west_fleet_rumour
		zin_west_rumour = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_truce_broken } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_truce_permanent } check_variable = { global.zin_west_truce < 50 } }
		zin_west_raid_roll = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_truce_broken } zin_west_historical = yes zin_west_past_truce_break = yes }
		zin_west_break_truce = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_west_council NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_route_chosen_notice } has_global_flag = zin_west_route_crossing }
		set_global_flag = zin_west_route_chosen_notice
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_west_month = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_west_month > 3 } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_west_month = 0 }
		zin_west_monthly = yes
	}
}
zin_west_keys_check = {
	# The Captains' Regency holds Parim and the western host is ashore: The Keys of Parim.
	set_global_flag = zin_west_keys_fired
	every_state = {
		limit = { zin_is_site_parim = yes controller = { zin_aenor_ruled_by_captains = yes } }
		controller = {
			country_event = { id = zin_west.55 }
		}
	}
}
zin_west_host_breaks = {
	# Strain 100 on the hold route: the host breaks and half the lift remains.
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_west_in_crossing = yes zin_west_has_divisions_in_middle_lands = yes }
		damage_units = { limit = { tag = THIS } org_damage = 0.4 str_damage = 0.2 ratio = yes army = yes }
		country_event = { id = zin_west.64 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_lift_factor = 0.5 }
	zin_west_begin_evacuation = yes
}
zin_west_rumour = {
	random_country = {
		limit = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes controls_state = 1328 }
		country_event = { id = zin_west.90 }
	}
}
zin_west_raid_roll = {
	# MTTH 240 days while the truce is thin: with 12 percent a month a raid falls on Gunwaith or Girdon in turn.
	set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = west_roll min = 0 max = 100 integer = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { west_roll < 12 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_west_raid_girdon_next }
			clr_global_flag = zin_west_raid_girdon_next
			Y08 = {
				country_event = { id = zin_west.21 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_global_flag = zin_west_raid_girdon_next
			Y07 = {
				country_event = { id = zin_west.21 }
			}
		}
	}
}
zin_west_monthly = {
	# Drift of grudge, truce and unity; resolve; the strain of the far shore; the fleet's return to trade.
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_west_is_western = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { west_d = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark > 39 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { west_d = 0.2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = zin_west_aenoran_gold }
			add_to_temp_variable = { west_d = -0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_eindil_heeded }
			add_to_temp_variable = { west_d = -0.2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_west_grudge > 70 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { west_d = -0.1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_west_grudge < 20 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { west_d = 0.1 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { zin_west_grudge = west_d }
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_west_grudge min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_eindil_heeded NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_west_heed_counted } }
			set_country_flag = zin_west_heed_counted
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -15 }
			zin_west_add_grudge = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_truce_broken } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_truce_permanent } }
		set_temp_variable = { west_d = 0 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { west_d = -0.5 }
		if = {
			limit = { Y07 = { has_idea = zin_gunwaith_war_thanes } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { west_d = -0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { Y07 = { has_idea = zin_gunwaith_kings_peace } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { west_d = 0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_west_ford_commission }
			add_to_temp_variable = { west_d = 0.3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark > 24 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { west_d = -0.3 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = west_d }
		zin_west_add_truce = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_west_council }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.5 }
		zin_west_add_unity = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { west_pairs = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_west_is_western = yes }
		every_enemy_country = {
			limit = { zin_west_is_western = yes }
			add_to_temp_variable = { west_pairs = 1 }
		}
	}
	divide_temp_variable = { west_pairs = 2 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { west_pairs = -1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_west_grey_ford_war }
		add_to_temp_variable = { west_pairs = 1 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = west_pairs }
	zin_west_add_unity = yes
	set_temp_variable = { west_gsum = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { west_wsum = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_west_is_western = yes OR = { has_country_flag = zin_west_council_member NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_council } } }
		set_temp_variable = { west_w = num_owned_states }
		set_temp_variable = { west_g = zin_west_grudge }
		multiply_temp_variable = { west_g = west_w }
		add_to_temp_variable = { west_gsum = west_g }
		add_to_temp_variable = { west_wsum = west_w }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { west_wsum > 0 } }
		divide_temp_variable = { west_gsum = west_wsum }
	}
	multiply_temp_variable = { west_gsum = constant:zin_west.resolve_grudge_w }
	divide_temp_variable = { west_gsum = 100 }
	set_temp_variable = { west_u = global.zin_west_unity }
	multiply_temp_variable = { west_u = constant:zin_west.resolve_unity_w }
	divide_temp_variable = { west_u = 100 }
	set_temp_variable = { west_f = global.zin_west_fleet }
	multiply_temp_variable = { west_f = constant:zin_west.resolve_fleet_w }
	divide_temp_variable = { west_f = 100 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_west_resolve = west_gsum }
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_west_resolve = west_u }
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_west_resolve = west_f }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_golden_king_dead }
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_west_resolve = constant:zin_west.bonus_king_dead }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_country = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes has_civil_war = yes } }
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_west_resolve = constant:zin_west.bonus_civil_war }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_leren_withdrawal }
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_west_resolve = constant:zin_west.bonus_leren_left }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_leren_honours_treaty has_global_flag = zin_leren_treaty_in_force }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.zin_west_resolve = constant:zin_west.bonus_honour }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns }
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_west_resolve = constant:zin_west.bonus_last_crowns }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns } check_variable = { global.zin_gathering_dark < 25 } any_country = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes has_government = democratic NOT = { any_enemy_country = { zin_west_is_western = yes } } controls_state = 1328 } }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.zin_west_resolve = constant:zin_west.bonus_calm }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_west_resolve min = 0 max = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_west_route = 0 } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_west_council } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -0.3 }
		zin_west_add_fleet = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { zin_west_holds_aenor_states = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { west_s = 0 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { west_s = 1.5 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_west_fleet < 40 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { west_s = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_zol_rising Y0U = { zin_west_has_divisions_in_middle_lands = yes } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { west_s = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_volgan_marches Y8D = { zin_west_has_divisions_in_middle_lands = yes } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { west_s = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eastern_invasion any_country = { has_country_flag = zin_region_east_lands zin_west_has_divisions_in_middle_lands = yes has_war_with = event_target:zin_west_foe } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { west_s = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_country = { zin_west_in_crossing = yes has_idea = zin_gunwaith_western_garrison } }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { west_s = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_country = { zin_west_in_crossing = yes has_idea = zin_west_hold_fast } }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { west_s = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = west_s }
		zin_west_add_strain = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_west_in_crossing = yes zin_west_has_divisions_in_middle_lands = yes }
			set_variable = { zin_west_strain_morale = global.zin_west_strain }
			divide_variable = { zin_west_strain_morale = constant:zin_west.modifier_divisor }
			multiply_variable = { zin_west_strain_morale = -1 }
			set_variable = { zin_west_strain_supply = global.zin_west_strain }
			divide_variable = { zin_west_strain_supply = constant:zin_west.modifier_divisor }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_west_strain_mod }
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_west_is_western = yes }
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
	}
}
